newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Mint tenders for 2,499,000 kg SHG zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Mint tenders for 2,499,000 kg SHG zinc.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said on Tuesday it was seeking 2,499,000 kg of Special High Grade zinc for delivery in the weeks beginning May 19 and May 26.
Offers should be submitted by fax to the Mint before 10 a.m. EDT (1400 GMT) on April 24.
The Mint said it sought the zinc in two lots. The first lot was for 1,900,000 kg of zinc to be delivered by rail car to Alltrista Corp, Alltrista Zinc Products Division, Greenville, Tenn.
The second lot was for 599,000 kg of zinc to be delivered by truck to LaSalle Rolling Mills of LaSalle, Ill.
